Our Urban Campus →

Live and learn in one of the best college locations in America. Our campus in downtown Portland provides inspiration and opportunity at every turn.
 

Big Possibilities. Low Tuition. →

PSU’s Tuition-Free Degree covers undergraduate tuition and most mandatory fees for eligible Oregon residents.

Apply to PSU →

Ready to apply? Turn big ideas into action with hands-on learning, career connections and a supportive community at PSU.

 

Go for Graduate School →

Discover new solutions, expand your network and advance your career in graduate programs led by some of the nation's best faculty and researchers.

News

For the Love

While talent and money will be needed for a new era of Portland State football, the cornerstone is a four-letter word rarely heard in a locker room, one many men are afraid to say — but one the Vikings’ new head coach preaches: love.
 

Street Outside PSU Native Center Renamed for Leader Rose Hill

Portland City Council voted unanimously to rename the stretch of SW Jackson Street outside Portland State University’s Native American Student and Community Center to SW Rose Hill Street. The change honors itway Rose Hill, a beloved Indigenous educator and Cultural Keeper who helped bring the center to life.

Why Climate Anxiety Inspires Some Youth to Act and Others to Freeze

A new study led by PSU communication professor Brianne Suldovsky explores how climate distress impacts young people. While anxiety motivates some youth to take action, feelings of climate contempt or frustration with alarmist messaging can trigger eco-paralysis, pointing to a need for more constructive communication strategies.
